findings.claim: 10-K列示的競爭者：傳統金融機構、金融科技、資管、加密原生平台，以及傳統資料中心業者轉做HPC、現有AI/HPC業者、雲端業者、前加密礦工轉型AI；資管業進入門檻低、可能費率壓縮
findings.excerpt: The asset management industry is highly competitive and has relatively low barriers to entry. As digital assets become more mainstream, additional competitors, potentially in large numbers, have and may begin providing asset management services with respect to digital assets.

findings.claim: 10-K指出資料中心業務競爭對手包含傳統資料中心業者、雲端業者與轉型AI的前加密礦工，競爭焦點為電力、連網、冷卻與地點
findings.excerpt: This includes traditional data center operators expanding into HPC, cloud infrastructure providers scaling capacity, and former crypto mining operators pivoting to meet the needs of AI workloads.
